One endpoint, zero code changes, 60–90% lower agent bills. Agent spend is exploding with almost no tooling to understand or control it. The neutral, cost-first control layer is the empty quadrant. records.name: CodeBurn

records.tagline: Bold pattern meets structured 100% cotton comfort.
records.description: Make a statement with our Men's Checkerboard Pattern Relaxed Fit Jeans. Crafted from heavy-duty, 100% non-stretch cotton denim, these trousers deliver a classic structured silhouette that ages uniquely with wear. Designed for all-day comfort with ample room through the seat and thighs, they pair effortlessly with solid tees, sneakers, or boots. Product URL: https://hipomarket.shop/products/mens-checkerboard-pattern-relaxed-fit-jeans

records.name: OllaVPN
records.tagline: Post-Quantum Cryptography
records.description: Download OllaVPN for Windows. Self-contained installer, SHA-256 verifiable. Lifetime free plan, no credit card.

records.name: Convyra Tools
records.tagline: 79 free browser tools. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.
records.description: Convyra Tools is a free collection of 79+ browser-based utilities across 10 categories — text tools, developer tools (JSON, Base64, JWT), calculators, generators, converters, color tools, SEO tools, security tools, date & time tools, and math tools. Everything runs entirely client-side. No account, no file uploads, no data leaves your browser. Actively growing toward 200+ tools. Would love feedback on what to add next.

records.name: Lettertrace
records.tagline: Track your AI visibility for free (using your own API keys!)
records.description: Lettertrace measures how often Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini mention your company. But there's a catch: it's free, developer-first, bring-your-own-key, and open source.

records.name: Media Sharing
records.tagline: Let AI agents put screenshots and videos on pull requests
records.description: GitHub has no API for attaching images to pull requests, so agents and CI ship blind. Argos Media Sharing fixes it: one command turns a screenshot or recording into a stable share link with ready-to-paste Markdown, and posts it on the PR automatically.

records.name: fun piano
records.tagline: music
records.description: You can play the piano online and play songs at the same time. The staff of the songs corresponds to the piano keys. Beginners who want to learn the piano can easily learn piano pieces through the software, and can also explore the staff you did not understand before. It is ideal for jazz students, classical pianists, and anyone interested in music.

records.name: Boardly
records.tagline: Kennel software that answers your phone and books the dog
records.description: Boarding, daycare and grooming software for independent kennels. An AI receptionist answers your phone 24/7 and books stays into your live calendar. Run the whole thing in plain English. Keep your own payment account, we take 0% of what your customers pay. 7-day free trial, no card.
